faq1Q: Does using Sezzle affect my credit score?
faq1A: No. Applying never runs a hard credit check, so it won't impact your score. You can also opt in to Sezzle Up,{sezzleUp} our free credit-building program.
faq2A: It does not cost anything to sign up for Sezzle and download the app. Depending on your order, a service fee (finance charge) may apply - and if it does, you'll see the exact amount before you check out, never after. A failed-payment fee of up to $15 may apply if a scheduled payment doesn't go through.
faq3A: Your first payment is due at checkout. The remaining payments are charged automatically every 2 weeks - over 6 weeks for Pay in 4{faq3APi5}.
faq4A: Yes. Open the Sezzle app, navigate to the 'Orders' tab, find your order, and move an upcoming payment date to better fit your budget.
faq5A: At this store and thousands of others online and in-store. Browse the Sezzle app to discover stores and exclusive deals.
